image_description: A street-level view of a bakery storefront named 'Boulangerie' (text appears mirrored/stylized). The facade features a large, curved glass display window filled with shelves of baked goods, illuminated by warm interior lighting. To the left is a glass door entrance with posted notices. Above the window is a white sign with blue decorative elements and stylized text. The building exterior includes beige paneling and adjacent closed metal shutters.
